name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: July Week 5 - Analog Values
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: Using clear separate values, like on or off.
words.example: The digital button reading was either HIGH or LOW.

words.definition: Using values that can change smoothly.
words.example: The analog knob reading changed gradually from low to high.

words.definition: A knob that changes an analog value.
words.example: The potentiometer controlled the brightness value.

words.definition: A part that changes an analog signal into a number.
words.example: The ADC changed the knob signal into a number.

words.definition: A value that can change in a program.
words.example: The variable stored the sensor reading in the sketch.

words.definition: A fast on/off signal used to control brightness or speed.
words.example: PWM made the LED look dimmer without turning fully off.

words.definition: How light or dark something is.
words.example: Brightness increased when the PWM value went up.

words.definition: A value measured by a sensor.
words.example: The reading changed when the student turned the knob.
